keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's Barbados begins in 1967 but independence was on 30 November 1966 (infobox 'Barbados Independence Act 1966 as a Commonwealth realm: 30 November 1966'). The shape is unchanged. Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire shape keeps the island's cell to 1968.

735 km2 against the infobox 439 km2: ratio 1.67, inside a factor of two; the seven-vertex outline is wider than the island. Bbox 13.01 to 13.34 N, 59.67 to 59.36 W is the island. Page records no territorial change to 2023.
Identical to the 1967 shape; no territorial change recorded to 2024.

region.text: the island of Barbados, independent of the United Kingdom

ledger.note: 30 November 1966: Barbados becomes independent. 'On 30 November 1966, Barbados moved toward political independence and assumed the status of a Commonwealth realm.' Second page (West Indies Federation): the island had been a Federation member 1958-1962 and the page's 'Little Eight' attempt was 'this time centred on Barbados' but 'ultimately proved fruitless' (undated on the page). The matching loss belongs in the British Colonial Empire dossier (Cliopatria drops the island only in 1969).

30 November 2021: Barbados becomes a republic within the Commonwealth. 'On 30 November 2021, Barbados transitioned to a republic within the Commonwealth'; Sandra Mason took office as president the same day. Same state, land and colour.

certainty.note: An island state: the coast is the frontier. The pages record no boundary dispute (the page opened contains no sentence on the Trinidad and Tobago maritime arbitration) and no territorial change.

notes: Page budget 2 of 2 (Barbados, West Indies Federation). Cliopatria's Barbados starts in 1967, one year after independence (30 November 1966); new keyframe barbados_1966 fills it. Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire shape keeps Barbados' cell through 1968 and drops it in 1969, so for 1967-1968 two Cliopatria states claim the same cell (the eu-11 dossier should carry the loss in November 1966). The West Indies Federation is not a Cliopatria row; its dossier west-indies-federation was written in parallel. The Barbados page gives the Federation only as 1958 to 1962; the Federation page gives Barbados' independence as '1966' without a month, so the 30 November 1966 date rests on the Barbados page alone. The page is silent on maritime boundary disputes; none coded. No rulers listed (a Commonwealth realm to 2021; the page names Sandra Mason as first president in 2021). Reviewer am-08-j (2026-10-19): west-indies-federation moved out of predecessors, which list the states whose land this state took at its birth: the Federation was disestablished on 31 May 1962 (infobox 'Part of the West Indies Federation: 03 January 1958 - 31 May 1962'), four years before independence, and the west-indies-federation dossier hands the island to british-colonial-empire. 'Barbados joined the short-lived British West Indies Federation from 1958 to 1962' (Barbados page).
